title: Round 11 / ECDLP-41: frontier exploration E — integer-structure / bit-access mechanisms
question: Integer-structure frontier: design and cheaply test ECDLP mechanisms that exploit exactly what all lab barriers leave unconstrained — order, bits, size and factorization of integer representatives of coordinates (comparisons, bit extraction, Legendre/power-residue tests, small-height lifts, carries) — and determine which known results (hard-core bits of ECDH, Boneh–Venkatesan HNP, comparison-tree lower bounds, Pollard-kangaroo/distinguished points) already constrain them.

claims: Own derivation (unreviewed): in Shoup's random-injective-encoding model the algorithm may compute arbitrarily on label strings (order, bits), so allowing order does not change the Omega(sqrt r) generic bound; an integer-structure algorithm beating sqrt r must be non-generic, i.e. contain a k-informative distinguisher of x(kP) from a random injection.

Experimental (toy, p=524309, two prime-order curves, seeds 1,2): no local integer correlation between x(kP) and x((k+j)P), j in {1,2,3,5} (grid chi2, bit-pair, difference histogram, small-difference count): negative in both seeds; planted-signal controls detected, negative controls clean.
Experimental: no concentration of index differences among integer-sorted neighbours (sorted distance 1,2,4) beyond a permutation null: negative in both seeds.

Experimental: three-term carry predicate c_k=[x_{k+1}+x_{k-1}>=p] shows no global bias or spectral line (200 even-shuffles, two seeds); nominal hits at different frequencies do not replicate: negative.

Hard-core-bit/HNP results (bit-predictor => DH) impose no lower bound on bit-access DL algorithms (no DH oracle; EC index relation not linear): derivation + abstract-level sources; Miller-height arithmetic: lifting to E(Q) needs ~2^18 bits numerators even at rank 29 for 256-bit p (heuristic count T^(rho/2)).

With comparisons and free constants, a binary-search tree over sorted x(kP) has 0 arithmetic nodes: the arithmetic-length measure of Theorem DT (HYP-dbe79a50) is vacuous unless tree size is charged (own observation, unreviewed). Nothing here changes the status of HYP-2de84d42.
